full_name: Crystal Z Campbell | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Arts Radcliffe-Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow Tulsa Artist Fellowship
bio: Crystal Z Campbell is a multidisciplinary artist, experimental filmmaker, and writer of African American, Filipino, and Chinese descent. Campbell engages with material, archival, and sonic traces of the witness through film/video, live performance, installation, sound, painting and texts.
